sources.title: China warns of 'necessary measures' after new US tariffs
sources.excerpt:
Beijing (AFP) – China warned Thursday it could take "necessary measures" after Washington unveiled new tariffs that risk shaking the uneasy truce in the countries' trade war that expires on January 10.

Issued on: 26/11/2026 - 10:59

US President Donald Trump and China's Xi Jinping are due to meet for the fourth time this year in December at a G20 summit in the United States.

Announcing the proposed levies for a raft of countries on Wednesday, Washington set the rate at 20 percent for China but warned it could double to 40 percent.

"China urges the United States to correct its erroneous practices and return to the right track of resolving issues through dialogue and consultation," Chinese commerce ministry spokesman He Yadong said.

"China will closely monitor developments and reserves the right to take necessary measures to firmly defend its legitimate rights and interests," He told a regular briefing.

sources.title: China unveils services trade plan to boost global competitiveness
sources.excerpt:
China has unveiled a new plan to expand services trade in five years, with a focus on emerging AI services, greater market openness and easier cross-border flows of capital, talent, technology and data.

The plan, jointly released on Thursday by the Ministry of Commerce and seven other government departments, sets out priorities for China's services trade development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030), aiming to enhance the international competitiveness of "China's services" by 2030.

For the first time, the plan sets out development priorities for both producer and consumer services, seeking to strengthen the competitiveness of integrated manufacturing and services offerings and cultivate new export advantages in tourism, culture and services with distinctive Chinese characteristics.

Developing new forms of AI services trade is another key feature of the plan. It calls for promoting the overseas expansion of AI-related services, including cloud computing and large models, in a prudent and orderly manner, while strengthening cooperation with Belt and Road partner countries in AI applications and industrial innovation.
sources.limits: CGTN报道；以商务部发布文件作政策原文交叉核对。

sources.title: Billions in Data Center Deals Grind to Halt After Chip Curbs
sources.excerpt:
Lenders have hit the brakes on billions of dollars in loans tied to Chinese firms ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent, as new US curbs on chip access threaten to upend Asia’s burgeoning AI debt financing market.

While Jensen Huang’s surprise return to Nvidia Corp. buoyed AI stocks briefly earlier this week, bankers remained concerned about the legal risks of financing data centers and neoclouds potentially facing stricter US export controls. Deals that were near the finish line are suddenly in doubt and lenders trying to sell down their exposure are struggling to find interested buyers.

sources.title: South Korea’s central bank raises rates, upgrades 2027 growth outlook
sources.excerpt:
The seven-member monetary policy board voted 5-2 to raise the 7-day repurchase rate by a quarter of a percentage point to 3.25%, its highest since November 2024, a decision forecast by 32 of 34 analysts surveyed by Reuters.

The bank also raised this year’s growth forecast to 3.9% from 3.3% previously and took its August outlook of 2.9% for next year to 4.1%, the fastest since 2021.

The hike was the BOK’s third this year, following back-to-back increases in July and August, and brought cumulative tightening to 75 basis points.

sources.title: Monetary Policy Decision & Opening Remarks to the Press Conference (November 26, 2026)
sources.excerpt:
The Monetary Policy Board of the Bank of Korea decided today to raise the Base Rate by 25 basis points from 3.00% to 3.25%. Domestic economic growth has further strengthened, inflation is projected to remain above the target level for a considerable time, and financial stability risks persist. The Board, therefore, judged that it is appropriate to raise the Base Rate by 25 basis points.

Five Monetary Policy Board members supported the decision to raise the Base Rate, while two members, Hwang Kunil and Lee Soohyung, voted against the decision, proposing to keep the Base Rate unchanged at 3.00%.

sources.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
sources.excerpt:
The Trump administration on Wednesday gave SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a long-lofty goal of Elon Musk's rocket company, in a move that has raised both skepticism and alarm among some scientists.

The U.S. Federal Communications Commission lauded its authorization as a historic first amid the artificial intelligence race. It said that SpaceX's one million "orbital compute modules" (forming a data center constellation called "Starmind") would process massive amounts of data that would be used back on Earth — and bring humans closer to harnessing "the full power of the sun."

A lengthier authorization order published by the FCC noted that the company must deploy at least "one authorized space station" by 2033 — and then gradually add more and more through 2040.
sources.limits: NPR转载AP；强调FCC核准不等于近期完成部署，技术与环境影响仍有争议。

sources.title: Exclusive: US chip curbs, distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development
sources.excerpt:
China’s Z.AI has fallen behind schedule on its next flagship AI model, while rival Moonshot AI expects the interval between major releases could double from six months to a year or longer if it loses access to overseas computing power, people familiar with the matter said.

The previously unreported details show how efforts by US AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic to prevent distillation, a technique in which developers train models using answers generated by more capable ones, have slowed Chinese AI development. Washington’s latest chip restrictions threaten further delays.

Z.AI, also known as Zhipu AI, had planned to release its next flagship model, GLM-5.5, this month but has yet to do so, two people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity.
sources.limits: Reuters主要依据未具名知情人士，Z.AI及Moonshot未立即回应。

sources.title: American tech defenses stall China’s next flagship AI models as Washington closes overseas chip loopholes
sources.excerpt:
Z.AI planned to release its next flagship AI model, GLM-5.5, this month, but has yet to do so, two people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity. The model is designed with roughly 3 trillion parameters, a measure of its size. One of the people said it has been held up partly by increasingly effective safeguards against distillation. Z.AI, also known as Zhipu AI, had hoped to complete training and release the model by year-end. The new U.S. computing restrictions could push its launch into the first quarter of 2027 or later, the person said.

Moonshot AI, a Beijing-based rival, expects the interval between major releases could double from six months to a year or longer if it loses access to overseas computing power, people familiar with the matter said.

sources.title: Egypt detains a driver suspected of causing Cairo tanker crash that killed 31
sources.excerpt:
Egyptian authorities said Thursday they detained the driver of a car suspected of causing a fuel tanker to overturn on a major highway surrounding Cairo, triggering a massive fire and killing at least 31 people during rush hour a day earlier.

The fire left 27 vehicles charred and injured 26 people, according to authorities. The public prosecutor’s office said DNA investigations were underway to identify the victims.

The prosecutors said in a statement on Facebook that authorities had detained the driver of the vehicle suspected of causing the fuel tanker to overturn. It said the driver told investigators he was speeding between lanes when he hit the oil tanker in the rear right.

sources.title: Fuel tanker crash ignites a massive fire on a highway surrounding Cairo, killing at least 31 people
sources.excerpt:
A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a massive fire on a major highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people, Egyptian authorities said.

The blaze on Ring Road, a key artery that encircles the Egyptian capital, also injured at least 21 people and left more than two dozen cars and motorcycles charred, according to the latest figures released by the Health Ministry.

The stretch of the highway where the crash occurred was in Waraq, a densely populated neighborhood in Giza, part of the Greater Cairo area, according to the Health Ministry.

At the scene, rescue workers were pulling people out of burning cars.

sources.title: Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly to add warning labels to GLP-1s amid wave of vision-loss lawsuits
sources.excerpt:
Novo Nordisk A/S and Eli Lilly are preparing to add a new federally required warning label to popular obesity drugs, as they face a growing body of lawsuits from users claiming the products caused damaging side effects that they did not adequately warn about.

The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) said in November it will require safety labelling changes for GLP-1s because of “potential increased risk” of non-arteritic anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy, or NAION.

sources.title: FDA Requires Safety Labeling Changes for GLP-1 RAs Due to Potential Increased Risk of Rare But Serious Eye Condition
sources.excerpt:
FDA Drug Safety Communication – November 9, 2026

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration is informing patients and health care providers of a potential increased risk of non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION) associated with use of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) medications. NAION is a rare condition that can result in acute, painless, decreased vision in one eye, including permanent vision loss.

The agency is requiring application holders for all GLP-1 RA medications to add information to the Warnings and Precautions section of labeling about the potential increased risk of NAION associated with use of these medications.
sources.limits: FDA公告发表于本刊新闻窗口前，只作背景；官方称潜在风险，不表示已经确认因果。

sources.title: China to track EU's follow-up probe into hybrid vehicles: commerce ministry
sources.excerpt:
2026-11-26 19:20:00

BEIJING, Nov. 26 (Xinhua) -- China will keep a close watch on any follow-up developments in the European Union's (EU) safeguard investigation into hybrid vehicles, and firmly protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese industries, the Ministry of Commerce said Thursday.

Ministry spokesperson He Yadong made the remarks when commenting on the EU's preliminary ruling in its global safeguard investigation into hybrid vehicles.

Prior to the EU's investigation, the two sides had conducted pre-initiation consultations and reached an understanding on hybrid vehicle trade arrangements in accordance with the three principles of "compliance with World Trade Organization (WTO) rules, non-discrimination, and respect for facts," said He.

The spokesperson reiterated that protectionism leads nowhere, and open cooperation is the right path forward.

sources.title: Commission imposes provisional import quotas on hybrid passenger vehicles
sources.excerpt:
The European Commission today published provisional safeguard measures setting import quotas for certain hybrid vehicles. These restrictions are needed to protect EU industry against a sharp recent increase in imports of such vehicles. The measures will enter into force on 1 December and follow an investigation that showed imports of hybrid vehicles into the EU have increased significantly since 2023.

While the safeguard measures implement the understanding reached at the second meeting of the EU-China Trade and Investment Consultations on 9 October 2026, to moderate China's exports of hybrids to the EU, they will apply to all hybrid imports regardless of their origin.

The Commission is imposing a quantitative restriction in the form of import quotas per exporting country, setting a maximum quantity of hybrid vehicles that may be imported into the EU for the duration of the provisional safeguard measures. Imports outside these quotas are not allowed.

The provisional safeguard measure will be in place for a maximum of 200 days.

sources.title: Vance says Jensen Huang won't need a pardon as scrutiny of Nvidia scandal builds in Washington
sources.excerpt:
Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday played down the possibility that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang could need a presidential pardon just days before the executive of the AI giant is expected to appear before a congressional committee.

Vance told reporters that Justice Department officials and “multiple officials in our national security apparatus” have confirmed that Huang is “under no investigation.” The vice president made the remarks after having a Thanksgiving Eve meal with troops at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base.

“I don’t think he needs a pardon at all,” Vance said. “I haven’t seen any evidence again that he committed a crime. And if there is evidence that he committed a crime, then that’s up to relevant authorities to actually bring a prosecution against him.”
sources.limits: 报道转述副总统公开说法；未独立证明政府调查状态或黄仁勋是否违法。

sources.title: Vance says he was assured Jensen Huang was not under DOJ investigation
sources.excerpt:
Vice President JD Vance said Wednesday that Attorney General Todd Blanche told him Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was not under investigation.

“I was told by the Department of Justice and multiple officials in our national security apparatus that he was under no investigation,” Vance told reporters in Ohio on Wednesday after being asked what assurances he had gotten that Huang was not under investigation. “Not even that he was about to be prosecuted; that he's under no investigation.”

On Tuesday, Trump left the door open to pardon Huang in an interview with the New York Post, but Vance said on Wednesday that the CEO doesn't need one.

“I don't think he needs a pardon at all,” Vance said. “I haven't seen any evidence again that he committed a crime.”
sources.limits: 报道反映Vance发言；未获司法部或英伟达回应，Vance表述不等同于完整调查结论。

claims.text: 规划针对2026—2030年，提出AI服务出海及要素跨境流动管理措施。
claims.quote:
The plan, jointly released on Thursday by the Ministry of Commerce and seven other government departments, sets out priorities for China's services trade development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030), aiming to enhance the international competitiveness of "China's services" by 2030.

For the first time, the plan sets out development priorities for both producer and consumer services, seeking to strengthen the competitiveness of integrated manufacturing and services offerings and cultivate new export advantages in tourism, culture and services with distinctive Chinese characteristics.

Developing new forms of AI services trade is another key feature of the plan. It calls for promoting the overseas expansion of AI-related services, including cloud computing and large models, in a prudent and orderly manner, while strengthening cooperation with Belt and Road partner countries in AI applications and industrial innovation.

sections.title: 规划新增的重点
paragraphs: 政策范围覆盖2026—2030年，强调生产性与生活性服务协同；AI云计算和大模型服务出海被列为新业态方向。商务部官方通知同时确认八部门印发该规划，正式发布日期为11月26日，通知载明文件日期为11月19日。

sections.title: 从规划方向到落地
paragraphs: 规划不只聚焦服务出口，还将跨境数据、人员、资金、技术流动列为便利化任务，说明服务贸易扩张涉及国内要素流动管理与对外开放的配套调整。现有报道没有列出具体实施时间表或量化目标，因此尚不能据此推断实际贸易增幅；后续需以配套规则和统计数据验证。

sections.title: 为何芯片规则会传导到贷款

stories.title: FCC有条件批准SpaceX部署百万颗轨道数据中心卫星，实施仍有门槛
stories.status: Pi自动生成 · 未经人工逐条核验
stories.takeaway: FCC对SpaceX的Starmind星座作出部分批准、部分延期并附条件的决定；这不是百万颗卫星立即部署许可。AP报道指出，计划面临技术、财务、环境与轨道安全争议。
stories.facts: FCC于11月25日发布决定，对SpaceX申请的百万颗Starmind卫星星座部分批准、部分延期并附条件，授权范围包括数据中心卫星的应急遥测、跟踪和指令通信。NPR转述AP称，FCC要求至少一颗授权卫星在2033年前部署，此后逐步增加至2040年；科学家质疑散热、成本和碰撞风险。
stories.affected: SpaceX、卫星运营商、天文研究机构及依赖低轨卫星服务的公众

claims.text: FCC对最多百万颗卫星的数据中心星座作部分批准、部分延期并附条件。
claims.quote:
The SpaceX Orbital Data Center System (Starmind) is a non-geostationary satellite orbit constellation of 1,000,000 satellites deployed into orbital shells at altitudes from 500 to 1,002 km.

Scope of Grant: Authority for radiofrequency communications for backup and emergency telemetry, tracking, & command (TT&C) for a constellation of 1,000,000 NGSO satellites to operate as data centers in space.

The application is GRANTED-IN-PART and DEFERRED-IN-PART, with conditions.

claims.text: NPR转述AP报道称至少一颗获准卫星须在2033年前部署，后续逐步增加，科学界提出技术和环境顾虑。
claims.quote:
A lengthier authorization order published by the FCC noted that the company must deploy at least "one authorized space station" by 2033 — and then gradually add more and more through 2040.

The world's richest man has long vowed to form vast, solar-powered data centers in space to help run AI tools on Earth. But scientists and industry experts have stressed enormous technical and financial obstacles, as well as a host of environmental concerns.

sections.title: 监管决定的边界
paragraphs: FCC书面决定采用部分批准、部分延期且附条件的方式，授权主要涉及应急通信频段，并要求部署前完成协调、遵守干扰与轨道碎片相关条件。AP称至少一颗卫星须在2033年前部署；这与近期建成百万颗卫星数据中心不是一回事。

sections.title: 目标与现实约束
paragraphs: FCC放行使SpaceX获得继续推进所需的部分监管许可，但AP报道所引专家指出散热、制造和发射成本及轨道碰撞都构成重大约束。现有批准文件也保留部分事项待定，因此“获得许可”不能据此推导项目商业化时间或经济可行性。

stories.title: 美芯片许可与反蒸馏措施挤压中国AI训练，Z.AI新模型或延至2027年
stories.status: Pi自动生成 · 未经人工逐条核验
stories.takeaway: Reuters采访称，Z.AI旗舰模型GLM-5.5已晚于原计划，Moonshot内部预期若海外算力中断，主力模型发布间隔可能从半年拉长至一年以上。公司未确认匿名信源细节，不能将预测视作既定延期。
stories.facts: Reuters报道，Z.AI原计划11月发布约3万亿参数的GLM-5.5，但截至报道时尚未推出；匿名知情人士称，蒸馏防护加强和美国海外算力许可规则都可能影响训练进度。Moonshot方面一名知情人士称，若海外算力完全中断，主要模型发布间隔可能从六个月延至一年或更久，Kimi K4可能推迟至2027年年中左右。两家公司未立即回应。
stories.affected: 中国AI模型开发商、海外云算力提供商及AI芯片供应链

claims.text: Z.AI尚未按原计划在11月推出GLM-5.5，匿名信源称上线可能推迟至2027年第一季度或更晚。
claims.quote:
Z.AI, also known as Zhipu AI, had planned to release its next flagship model, GLM-5.5, this month but has yet to do so, two people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity.

The model, designed with roughly 3 trillion parameters - a measure of its size - has been held up partly by increasingly effective safeguards against distillation, one of the people said.

Z.AI had hoped to complete training and release the model by year-end, but the new US computing restrictions could push its launch into the first quarter of 2027 or later, the person said.

claims.text: Moonshot预期海外算力若完全中断，主要模型发布间隔可能由六个月延长至一年或更久。
claims.quote:
The AI developer internally expects its usual six-month interval between major releases could stretch to 12 months or longer if its overseas computing access is cut off entirely, the person said, adding that computing capacity available in China could not make up the shortfall.

Its next flagship model, Kimi K4, could be delayed until around the middle of 2027, the person estimated.

sections.title: 模型进度与算力依赖
paragraphs: 报道描述的是匿名信源对公司内部计划的说法：GLM-5.5尚未按11月计划推出；Moonshot估计海外算力断供可能拉长发布周期。The Independent转载并复述相同说法，作为交叉读取而非独立确证。

sections.title: 管制传导机制
paragraphs: Reuters将潜在延期归因于两类瓶颈：海外数据中心使用先进芯片新增许可要求，以及OpenAI、Anthropic等加强模型输出蒸馏防护后可用训练数据减少。两家公司的回应尚未取得，具体进度和因果权重仍依据匿名受访者描述，不能据此断言中国AI研发整体放缓。

paragraphs: 事故发生在高峰时段的城市环路，油罐车倾覆后燃料外泄并引发连片车辆起火，显示重型危险品运输与拥堵道路叠加时会放大人员疏散难度。AP指出埃及交通事故致死长期严重，但本案责任认定仍须等待调查与司法程序。

stories.title: 诺和诺德、礼来将为GLP-1药物增加罕见视力风险警示
stories.status: Pi自动生成 · 未经人工逐条核验
stories.takeaway: FDA要求GLP-1药品标签加入NAION潜在风险提示；《海峡时报》报道礼来已更新处方信息、诺和诺德准备调整。警示不等于确认药物导致视神经损伤，也不代表企业承认诉讼主张。
stories.facts: FDA要求GLP-1受理持有人在药品说明书中补充非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（NAION）的潜在风险提示。《海峡时报》报道礼来已更新部分处方信息，诺和诺德也准备添加警示；两家公司仍表示会继续应诉。FDA称风险可能增加但罕见，标签变化本身不证明因果关系。

claims.text: FDA要求GLP-1药品补充NAION潜在风险警示，礼来已更新处方信息。
claims.quote:
The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) said in November it will require safety labelling changes for GLP-1s because of “potential increased risk” of non-arteritic anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy, or NAION.

Sometimes called an “eye stroke”, it can cause sudden vision loss without pain, usually in one eye.

Adding the label will not mean the drugmakers are admitting to a causal link – that is up to the plaintiffs and their experts to try to prove.

Lilly has already updated the prescribing information for its drugs to include a warning about NAION, according to labelling published in a federal government database.

claims.text: 诺和诺德称现有数据不能证明因果关系，并表示将继续应诉。
claims.quote:
Both companies say that patient safety is a top priority and that they will continue to defend themselves in court.

On the NAION claims, a Lilly spokesperson said the company “appreciates the court’s careful consideration of the scientific evidence and its impact on important threshold issues, including causation”.

“Novo continues to believe the data do not establish a cause-and-effect relationship and we remain confident in the benefit-risk profile of our GLP-1 medicines,” according to a company statement after the FDA’s announcement.

sections.title: 标签变化与因果边界
paragraphs: FDA于11月9日要求此类药物补充NAION潜在风险提示。窗口内报道显示礼来已更新处方信息，诺和诺德准备添加标签；公司抗辩并未因标签调整而消失，FDA也未宣布已确认药物与NAION存在因果关系。

sections.title: 患者信息意义
paragraphs: 新增说明使处方沟通需要覆盖突发、无痛性单眼视力下降等风险信号，但不意味着所有使用者都会发病，亦不能替代医生对个体获益与风险的评估。FDA把NAION描述为罕见但可能造成永久视力损失的状况。

stories.facts: 新华社报道，商务部发言人何亚东表示中方将跟进欧盟混动车保障调查，并要求欧方遵守中欧磋商共识、按世贸规则公正调查。欧委会11月24日原文显示，配额措施12月1日生效，适用于所有来源地，临时措施最长200天；进口超出配额不获准入。

claims.text: 商务部称将跟进欧盟后续调查并维护中国产业权益。
claims.quote: China will keep a close watch on any follow-up developments in the European Union's (EU) safeguard investigation into hybrid vehicles, and firmly protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese industries, the Ministry of Commerce said Thursday.

claims.text: 欧盟临时混动车配额措施12月1日生效，适用于所有来源地，最长200天。
claims.quote:
The European Commission today published provisional safeguard measures setting import quotas for certain hybrid vehicles. These restrictions are needed to protect EU industry against a sharp recent increase in imports of such vehicles. The measures will enter into force on 1 December and follow an investigation that showed imports of hybrid vehicles into the EU have increased significantly since 2023.

While the safeguard measures implement the understanding reached at the second meeting of the EU-China Trade and Investment Consultations on 9 October 2026, to moderate China's exports of hybrids to the EU, they will apply to all hybrid imports regardless of their origin.

The Commission is imposing a quantitative restriction in the form of import quotas per exporting country, setting a maximum quantity of hybrid vehicles that may be imported into the EU for the duration of the provisional safeguard measures. Imports outside these quotas are not allowed.

The provisional safeguard measure will be in place for a maximum of 200 days.

sections.title: 中方回应与措施时间表
paragraphs: 中方称将跟进调查并维护产业权益。欧盟措施来自临时保障调查，所有来源地适用，12月1日生效，期限最多200天，配额外进口不准进入。欧委会称调查认定进口增长对欧盟产业构成迫近严重损害威胁；这属于欧委会的调查结论。

sections.title: 贸易影响的边界
paragraphs: 临时配额直接限制的是超过分配数量的进口，而不是只针对中国的单一国别惩罚；欧委会文件明确措施适用于所有来源地。中国出口商受到的实际约束取决于国别配额与后续正式调查，现有材料未提供逐国配额数，不能据此量化中国企业损失。

stories.takeaway: 工信部等三部门发布经国务院同意的建设方案，目标到2030年形成覆盖完善的新一代通信网，适时开展6G网络建设，并基本建成低轨卫星互联网系统。文件设定规划目标，不表示相关网络已经建成或6G商业服务已启动。
stories.facts: 新华社报道，工信部、国家网信办和国家发展改革委发布新一代通信网建设实施方案，提出2030年前完善基础、空间、国际和融合网络，适时开展6G网络建设，并基本建成低轨卫星互联网系统。工信部页面确认三部门联合印发且经国务院同意；文件成文日期为11月17日，页面发布日期为11月26日。
stories.affected: 通信设备与网络建设企业、卫星互联网运营商及依赖数字基础设施的行业

claims.text: 方案提出到2030年推进6G网络建设并基本建成低轨卫星互联网系统。
claims.quote:
The plan targets advancing 6G network development at an appropriate time and basically completing the construction of a low-Earth-orbit satellite internet system by 2030.

China also expects to promote the large-scale development of integrated networks like the Industrial Internet and the Internet of Vehicles, significantly improve smart development, and further strengthen the industrial ecosystem, according to the plan.

claims.text: 该方案由工信部、国家网信办、国家发展改革委联合印发并经国务院同意。
claims.quote:
《新一代通信网建设实施方案》已经国务院同意，现印发给你们，请认真贯彻执行。

工业和信息化部

国家网信办

国家发展改革委

sections.title: 2030年网络建设目标
paragraphs: 方案涵盖基础、空间、国际和融合网络，提出适时开展6G网络建设，2030年前基本建成低轨卫星互联网系统，并推动工业互联网、车联网规模化发展。文件是建设规划，并非6G商用落地公告。

sections.title: 规划目标与已建成能力的区别
paragraphs: 方案同时强调网络安全、绿色低碳和资源保障，说明6G推进与卫星网络、算力及现有通信网升级同步布局。文本给出2030年目标而没有在报道中提供预算执行、工程进度或商业服务节点，故不能由政策发布推断投资已完成或运营能力已经形成。

stories.title: 美国副总统万斯称黄仁勋无需赦免，并称其未受司法部调查
stories.status: Pi自动生成 · 未经人工逐条核验
stories.takeaway: JD Vance在俄亥俄公开表示，司法部及国家安全官员告知他Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang未受调查，且不需要总统赦免。报道记录的是副总统转述的政府说法，不等于独立确认调查范围或作出司法结论。
stories.facts: AP与CNBC报道，美国副总统JD Vance周三称司法部和国家安全部门官员告知他，Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang未受调查；在特朗普称赦免“始终是一种选择”后，Vance表示黄仁勋不需要赦免，并称未看到其犯罪证据。报道未取得司法部、白宫或英伟达对该说法的即时回应。
stories.affected: Nvidia、公司股东与员工、美国国会审查人员及关注芯片出口管制的公众

claims.text: Vance称司法部及国家安全官员告知他黄仁勋未受调查，并表示黄仁勋不需要赦免。
claims.quote:
Vance told reporters that Justice Department officials and “multiple officials in our national security apparatus” have confirmed that Huang is “under no investigation.” The vice president made the remarks after having a Thanksgiving Eve meal with troops at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base.

“I don’t think he needs a pardon at all,” Vance said. “I haven’t seen any evidence again that he committed a crime. And if there is evidence that he committed a crime, then that’s up to relevant authorities to actually bring a prosecution against him.”

claims.text: 特朗普前一日称赦免仍是一种选择，司法部、白宫和英伟达未立即回应CNBC关于相关说法的询问。
claims.quote:
On Tuesday, Trump left the door open to pardon Huang in an interview with the New York Post, but Vance said on Wednesday that the CEO doesn't need one.

“I don't think he needs a pardon at all,” Vance said. “I haven't seen any evidence again that he committed a crime.”

sections.title: 副总统公开表态
paragraphs: Vance称司法部及国家安全官员告诉他黄仁勋未受调查，并称未见其犯罪证据，因此不需要总统赦免。AP与CNBC均记录了在俄亥俄的发言；发言属于行政部门官员对调查状态的表述，不是法院判决。

sections.title: 调查状态仍需精确表述
paragraphs: 这番话涉及政府对英伟达领导人国家安全与合规风险的公开说明，且黄仁勋此前复任引发国会审视。现有报道只证明Vance这样转述，并未提供司法部正式文件界定调查对象、调查范围或终结状态，故不能把“未受调查”扩写为全部相关客户或出口事项均已结案。
